'''Miaoshan''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Idle)
:'''Yetian:''' Would you stop coming around here all the time? You're making us all nervous.
:'''Miaoshan:''' When is Heming coming back?
:'''Yetian:''' Well, you don't miss people by doing this. What kind of man stares at a list of fallen soldiers every day, looking for his sweetheart's name?
:'''Yetian:''' And the list hasn't even been updated for so long... If you carry on like this, your life is over!
:'''Miaoshan:''' I'm worried about her! She hasn't responded to my calls for over thirty-six hours!
:'''Yetian:''' They're fighting on the front lines. What do you think they're doing, camping?
:'''Miaoshan:''' You're right... I'll go back to Mr. [[Yhan]] later and sign up for ten more training sessions!
:'''Miaoshan:''' If I train hard, maybe I'll get a chance to join her on the frontlines.
:'''Yetian:''' This is getting to sappy for us. We won't tag along again!
{{Dialogue End}}
